content: Yoosefi Bana Qoncisetha
He wode Yoosefi ba aylleta sinthan gencanaw danda7iboona gisho, “Asa ubbaa ta sinthafe kessite” yaagidi waassis. Hessa gisho, Yoosefi ba ishatas bana erisida wode iyara oonika allagi baawa.
I ba qaala dhoqu oothidi, Gibxeti iya si7ana gakanaw yeekis; kawa soo asayka he woriya si7idosona.
Yoosefi ba ishatako, “Taani Yoosefabay. Ta aaway hanno gakanaw paxa de7ii?” yaagidi oychis. Shin iya ishati daro dagammida gisho, iyaw aykoka zaaranaw danda7ibookona.
Yaanin, Yoosefi ba ishatako, “Taako haa shiiqite” yaagis. Enti iyako shiiqin I enta, “Taani hinte tana Gibxe biitta bayzida hinte ishaa Yoosefa.
Ha77i hinte tana bayzida gisho, qiirotofitenne hintena baaddofite. Ayis giiko, Xoossay tana hintefe sinthe kiitiday asa shempo ashshanaasa.
Ha biitta koshi gelin haysi nam7antho laythi. Asi goyonna woyko cakonna hara ichashu laythati buroo de7oosona.
Shin taani sa7an hinte sheeshanne hintena malaalsiya ogen ashshana mela Xoossay tana hintefe sinthe kiittis.
Hessa gisho, tana ha bessa kiittiday Xoossafe attishin, hintena gideketa. I tana Gibxe kawas zoriya aawa, iya aqo ubbaa bolla godanne Gibxe biitta haariya asi oothis.
“Ha77i ellesidi guye ta aawako bidi iyako, ne na7ay Yoosefi haysada yaagees giite; ‘Xoossay tana Gibxe biitta ubbaa bolla godaa kessis; neeni gam7onna taako haaya.
Ne nayta, ne nayta nayta, ne dorsaa, ne deesha, ne mehiyanne new de7iyaba ubbaa ekada haaya; ta matan Geesame biittan de7aasa.
Buroo ichashu kosha laythati attidosona. Nena, ne soo asaanne ne mehiya koshi qohonna mela taani nena muzana’ ” yaagis.
Qassika Yoosefi entako, “Hinteka, ta ishaa Biniyaameyka, ha hintera odetey tuma tana Yoosefa gideysa hinte ayfiyan be7ideta.
Taw Gibxe biittan de7iya gita bonchuwanne hinte be7idaba ubbaa ta aawas odite. Ta aawaka ellesidi haa ekidi yiite” yaagis.
Yoosefara Biniyaamera nam7ay wolu qoomidi yeekidosona
Yoosefi yeekishe ba ishata ubbaa yeeris. Hessafe guye, iya ishati iyara odetidosona.
Yoosefa ishata yuussaa worey kawo keethi gakida wode kawoynne iya moorinnati ufaytidosona.
Kawoy Yoosefako, “Neeni ne ishatako yaaga; hinte hareta caanidi, Kanaane biitta simmite.
Hinte aawanne hinte soo asa ekidi, guye taako haa yiite. Taani hintew Gibxe biittan ubbaafe lo77iya bessa immiko, he biitta modhuwa hinte kaashana.
Qassika, banta nayta, banta machetanne banta aawa ehanaw Gibxefe gita para gaare eki baana mela enta kiita.
Gibxe biittan de7iya ubbaafe aadhidi lo77iyabay entassa gidiya gisho, banta aggidi yaa aquwas qoponna mela entaw oda” yaagis.
Yaatin Isra7eele adde nayti kawoy gidaysada oothidosona. Yoosefi Kawoy kiitidaysada gita para gaaretanne oges shinqeka entaw immis.
Enta ubbaas huuphen huuphen ooratha ma7o immis. Shin Biniyaames tammanne usupun kilo giraame deexiya biranne ichashu kumetha ma7o immis.
I ba aawas Gibxen de7iyabaape lo77iyaba ubbaa tammu adde haren caanidi, qassi oges kathi, uythinne hara kathi tammu macca haretan caanidi yeddis.
Yaatidi, Yoosefi ba ishata moyzishe, entako, “Ogiyan bishe ooyetofite” yaagis.
Enti Gibxefe dendidi, Kanaane biittan de7iya banta aawa Yayqoobako simmidosona.
Enti Yayqoobako, “Yoosefi paxa de7ees. I hessafe aadhidi Gibxe biitta ubbaa haarees” yaagidosona. Yayqoobi dagammidi, wozana dhayda gisho, enti giyaba ammanibena.
Shin enti Yoosefi entaw odidaba ubbaa iyaw odin, qassika iya eki yaana mela I yeddida gita para gaareta I be7in iyaw shempoy simmis.
Isra7eeley, “Hiza ta ammanetas. Ta na7aa Yoosefi hanno gakanaw paxa de7ees. Ta hayqanaape sinthe bada iya be7ana” yaagis.
